finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1200 Cr, EBITDA margin = 20%, Debt = ₹200 Cr, Interest rate = 8%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 10%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹240 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹16 Cr = ₹224 Cr.
New revenue = ₹1080 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹216 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹200 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-24 Cr — notice how a 10% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
